background: Monzo is a UK app-only bank, one of the largest digital banks in Britain by customer numbers, funded by retail current-account deposits and lending mainly through overdrafts, personal loans and cards, with much of its balance sheet held in cash and gilts.
synthesis: None of the three main agencies rates the bank, so the filings are the only evidence. Liquidity is exceptional, with LCR of 1039% and NSFR of 745% far into the top quarter of UK small banks, and CET1 of 27.3% is also in the top quarter. The weaker figure is leverage of 8.3%, below the peer median, which reflects a balance sheet heavy in cash and gilts rather than risk-weighted lending. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
